new_statements.quote: En plus du nombre relativement bas d'éléments lexicaux et d'un choix quelque peu arbitraire (du point de vue lexicologique), cela se manifeste aussi dans la qualité de l'analyse phonologique, morphologique (voir 2. plus bas) et surtout tonologique; la notation des tons (bas et hauts) est tout à fait tentative et provisoire.
new_statements.translation: Besides the relatively low number of lexical items and a somewhat arbitrary selection (from a lexicological point of view), this [the by-product nature of the material] also shows in the quality of the phonological, morphological (see 2. below) and above all tonological analysis; the notation of the tones (low and high) is entirely tentative and provisional.
new_statements.citation: Kastenholz, Raimund. 2001. Le jèri.kúò (langue mandé des Jéri): répartition géographique et matériel lexical. Mandenkan 37: 49-88.
new_statements.locator: p. 52 (PDF page 3, left half of the two-page spread), §1 introductory remarks before the village list; segment inventory §2.1-2.2 pp. 56-57
new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Opened (21 PDF pages, each a two-page spread, no text layer) and rendered PDF page 3 to an image: the left half carries printed folio 52 and the sentence "En plus du nombre relativement bas d'éléments lexicaux et d'un choix quelque peu arbitraire (du point de vue lexicologique), cela se manifeste aussi dans la qualité de l'analyse phonologique, morphologique (voir 2. plus bas) et surtout tonologique; la notation des tons (bas et hauts) est tout à fait tentative et provisoire." is there word for word (the scanned file has the usual scan noise, but the page image matches the quote exactly). Read the surrounding section: §0-1 is an avant-propos (article written 1991, wordlist of 630 items from…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Jeli is described as a two-tone language (low vs. high). Neither Kastenholz 2001 nor Vydrine's review of the only grammar (Tröbs 1998) says anything about word stress or accent; no source found makes a stress statement. Corroborating second-hand line: Vydrine 2000: 95 'L'opposition de deux tons (haut et bas) est signalée, sans autres détails concernant le fonctionnement du système tonal.' (file).
new_statements.exceptions: Kastenholz notes that citation-form tone rules may differ (fn. 95, on kpa 'tuer' vs 'mourir'), and that tone notation is uncertain for most village varieties (fn. 86); Vydrine notes Tröbs' and Kastenholz' tone marks sometimes disagree (dialect or transcription error).
new_statements.domain_note: Lexical tone on words in citation form from wordlists collected in c. 12 Jeli villages (Korhogo, Sandrigué, Tolma, Zouméné etc.); nothing on phrase-level prosody or stress.
new_statements.identity_note: Kastenholz 2001 covers Jeri Kuo / Jeli as spoken in about a dozen Jeli villages of the Korhogo prefecture (Sandrigué, Tolma, Zouméné, Katala, Guiémbé, Nangakaha etc.), with tone noted as varying/uncertain across villages; same language as Glottolog jeri1242 (ISO jek). Tröbs 1998 (reviewed by Vydrine) describes the same language from a 5-month stay in the Korhogo area. Jalkunan (jalk1242, Burkina Faso) and Jogo/Ligbi (ligb1244) are sister languages, not covered here.

sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Says only that Jeli has low and high tones and that the tone notation is tentative (p. 52); §2.1-2.2 (pp. 56-57) give the segment inventory and nasal archiphonemes; no prosody beyond tone. Scan had no text layer; scanned with tesseract eng at 300 dpi and the key sentence checked against the image.

sources.note: Second-hand summary of Tröbs 1998's phonological sketch: 7 vowel qualities, vowel length contrastive, 'L'opposition de deux tons (haut et bas) est signalée, sans autres détails concernant le fonctionnement du système tonal' (p. 95); tones are not marked outside the phonetics chapter (p. 99).
